text.6:152: And approach not the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better, till he reach maturity. Give full measure and full weight, in justice. We task not any soul beyond its scope. And if ye give your word, do justice thereunto, even though it be (against) a kinsman; and fulfil the covenant of Allah. This He commandeth you that haply ye may remember.
text.7:8: The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful.
text.7:9: And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they used to wrong Our revelations.
text.7:85: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother, Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! a clear proof hath come unto you from your Lord; so give full measure and full weight and wrong not mankind in their goods, and work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering thereof. That will be better for you, if ye are believers.
text.11:84: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him! And give not short measure and short weight. Lo! I see you well-to-do, and lo! I fear for you the doom of a besetting Day.
text.11:85: O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice, and wrong not people in respect of their goods. And do not evil in the earth, causing corruption.
text.21:47: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
text.23:102: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
text.23:103: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
text.42:17: Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance. How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh.
text.55:7: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
text.55:8: That ye exceed not the measure,
text.55:9: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
text.57:25: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
text.101:6: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
